title: 7x24 Grid and Inspector Drawer Collide at 1024px Screen Width
details: At 1024px width, Tailwind 'lg:flex-row' kicks in. The modal container is 976px wide. The inspector drawer claims 380px (shrink-0), leaving only 596px for the grid. The grid has 'min-w-[720px]' (+ 64px padding = 784px), resulting in a 188px overflow and forcing horizontal scrolling across all 24 hours.

title: Vertical Space Squashed on 768px Display (706px Modal Height)
details: On a 768px vertical display (1024x768 / 1366x768), 92vh yields 706px. The modal top header, KPI ribbon, wrapped filter bar, and footer consume 288px, leaving only ~418px. The inspector model list is cramped into <300px, cutting off visible models and creating double scrollbars.

title: Modal Content Clips Above and Below Screen at 480px Viewport Height
details: ModalShell uses 'fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-4' without 'overflow-y-auto' on the backdrop. When child modals like SettingsModal or TierManagerModal enforce 'min-h-[580px]' (total 612px with padding), they exceed 480px viewport height. The modal header (with title & X button) and modal footer (with action buttons) are clipped offscreen and cannot be scrolled to.

title: Center Deck Card Horizontally Squashed at 1024px with Quick-Edit Open
details: Opening Quick-Edit ('showInspector') mounts an aside of 320px ('w-80 shrink-0'). On 1024px width, available width drops to 704px. The triage card requires 720px (max-w-2xl 672px + 48px padding), causing horizontal cramping and squashing card elements.

title: PiP Header Username and Action Buttons Collide at minWidth 320px
details: BrowserWindow minWidth is 320px. The floating control bar has 296px width. Left brand/live elements (72px) plus 5 right control buttons (148px) leave only ~76px for username. The username span has 'max-w-[170px]' without dynamic flex-shrink constraints, causing it to push against and overlap the controls.

title: TopNav Clips and Overflows at Viewports Below 768px Width (e.g. 640x480)
details: TopNav uses 'h-14 flex items-center justify-between gap-3' without responsive collapsing or hamburger menu. Left brand + nav items (470px) plus right theme switcher + actions + iMac window controls (260px) require ~762px minimum width. Below 768px (e.g. 640x480 or high-DPI scaling), items collide, clip, or push offscreen.

title: Status Badges (Top-Left) and Action Buttons (Top-Right) Directly Overlap on Grid Cards
details: On Live Monitor grid cards, the top-left badges container ('absolute top-2 left-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 pointer-events-none') renders status ('PUBLIC'), schedule confidence ('EXPECTED (< 1 HR) · 85%'), and viewer counts (~272px). The top-right actions container ('absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1') renders 'Stage', 'Wall', 'PiP', and 'Hide' buttons (~168px). Total required width is ~456px. In 3, 4, or 5-column grid modes (card widths 165px–260px), action buttons render directly over status badges, obscuring viewers and schedule text.

title: 100-Character Username in RapidSorter Card Does Not Truncate in Child Span
details: In RapidSorterView.tsx (line 778), the parent div has 'truncate' but the child '@{activeModel.username}' has no width or truncation constraints. Similarly, line 818 'Up next: @{nextModel.username}' lacks 'truncate' or 'break-all', causing long 100-character handles to break outside card borders.

title: 100-Character Model Name in ModalShell Pushes Close "X" Button Offscreen
details:
In ModalShell.tsx (lines 53-68), the title container has no 'min-w-0' and '

{title}

' has no 'truncate' or 'break-words'. When editing a model with a 100-character name ('Edit Model — aaaaa...'), the title forces the header to expand horizontally, pushing the Close 'X' button off the screen.

title: International/Unicode/Symbol Usernames Fall Back to Stale "MS" Initials
details: In src/utils/media.ts:31, getInitials() strips all non-ASCII characters ('replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_ ]/g, " ")'). For international models (Japanese, Cyrillic, emoji, or zero-width handles), the cleaned string is empty and returns hardcoded 'MS' (legacy ModelSort acronym instead of WatchPulse 'WP').

title: 30+ Tags or Multi-Line Bios Push Action Buttons Below Viewport Fold on 768px Screens
details:
In RapidSorterView.tsx (lines 843-863), tags are rendered in a boundless 'flex flex-wrap gap-1.5' container, and notes are rendered in '

{activeModel.notes}

' without 'max-h' or overflow scrolling. When models have 30+ tags or multi-paragraph bios, the triage card expands vertically by hundreds of pixels, pushing the Tier Action Deck buttons completely out of view on 768px displays.

title: Toast Notifications Unreadable in Light Mode (Contrast Ratio: 1.02:1)
details: In src/App.tsx:251-265, toast cards use dark tones 'bg-[#101C18]', 'bg-[#1B160F]', 'bg-[#1D1014]', and 'bg-[#121622]'. In src/index.css:390, '[data-theme="light"] .text-slate-100' forces text to near-black '#0F172A !important'. Because toast backgrounds are not overridden in Light Mode, dark text is rendered directly on pitch-black toast backgrounds with a contrast ratio of 1.02:1 (failing WCAG AA 4.5:1).

category: Schedule Matrix Light Mode Cell Contrast Failure
title: Heatmap Low-Density Cells Illegible in Light Mode (Contrast Ratio: 1.61:1)
details: In ScheduleMatrixModal.tsx:617, low-density cells use 'bg-indigo-950/60' (near-black indigo background). In index.css:425, '[data-theme="light"] .text-indigo-300' forces text color to '#3730A3 !important' (dark indigo). Dark indigo text on dark indigo background produces an illegible contrast ratio of 1.61:1.

title: Inline Notes Input Plunges into Darkness on Focus in Light Mode (Contrast Ratio: 1.32:1)
details: In DataGridView.tsx:657, the inline notes input has 'focus:bg-[#0B0E15]' (hardcoded pitch black). In Light Mode, text color is forced to dark slate '#1E293B !important'. When the user clicks into the note field, the background suddenly snaps to pitch black while typing in dark text (contrast ratio 1.32:1).

category: Schedule Matrix Button Light Mode Contrast
title: Inspector "Watch" Button Text Turns Near-Black on Indigo in Light Mode (Contrast Ratio: 2.84:1)
details: In ScheduleMatrixModal.tsx:886, the 'Watch' button uses 'bg-indigo-600/80 ... text-white'. In index.css:410-421, the white-text preservation selector only targets exact '.bg-indigo-600'. Because opacity modifier '/80' is used, '[data-theme="light"] .text-white' turns the text to near-black '#0F172A !important', rendering black text on dark indigo.

title: ArchiveBate Pill Invisible in Light Mode (Contrast Ratio: 1.85:1)
details: In LinkPillGroup.tsx:68 & 137, ArchiveBate links use 'text-violet-300' (#C4B5FD). Unlike indigo, emerald, sky, and amber, index.css has NO light mode override for 'text-violet-300'. Light pastel lavender text on a white card yields a contrast ratio of only 1.85:1 (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1).

title: Missing Light Mode Override for bg-[#10131C] in DataGridView table header (thead)
details: In src/index.css:451-464 and 479-494, specific dark hex and alpha classes are overridden with light surfaces. However, bg-[#10131C] in DataGridView table header (thead) was omitted from the override list, remaining pitch black in Light Mode.

title: Grey Mode Lacks Component Background Overrides for Hardcoded Dark Hex Surfaces
details: In src/index.css:26-44, Grey Mode defines --bg-canvas: #161922 and --bg-surface: #20242F. However, unlike Light Mode, there are zero overrides for hardcoded dark classes ('bg-[#0C0F16]', 'bg-[#0B0E15]', 'bg-[#10131C]'). Because these hex values are darker than the grey canvas (#161922), they appear as stark, mismatched black blotches instead of unified frosted studio glass.

category: Broken Glass Refraction in Light Mode
title: Heavy Saturated Aura Glow Orbs Bleed Through Semi-Transparent Light Glass
details: FloatingAuraBackground.tsx mounts high-opacity orbs ('from-blue-600/40 via-indigo-600/30 to-violet-700/20' and 'from-violet-600/30 via-fuchsia-600/20'). In Light Mode, cards and headers have semi-transparent backgrounds ('--glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84)'). As the GPU aura drifts, dense dark purple/azure splotches refract through the frosted glass behind text and inputs, breaking visual clarity.

title: Unresolved "shadow-elevation" Class in ModalShell and Kanban Cards
details: 'shadow-elevation' is referenced in src/components/common/ModalShell.tsx:47 and src/components/views/KanbanView.tsx:484. However, neither tailwind.config.js nor src/index.css defines this utility, causing it to fail silently and produce no box-shadow elevation.
